steps.title: Introduce cysteine by mutagenesis
steps.instruction: Perform site‑directed mutagenesis to insert a cysteine residue into ubiquitin constructs (e.g., an N‑terminal Met‑Cys extension). Generate two constructs: one tag‑less and one with a C‑terminal His6 tag, both to be used for downstream labeling with Cy3‑maleimide.

steps.title: Express and purify tag‑less wild‑type and cysteine ubiquitin
steps.instruction: Produce tag‑less wild‑type S. cerevisiae ubiquitin and the cysteine‑containing MCM‑Ub, then purify them by cation exchange and size‑exclusion chromatography while keeping the cysteine reduced with 1 mM TCEP.

substeps.instruction: Transform E. coli BL21‑star (DE3) with the appropriate expression plasmid; heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, then recover for 1 h at 37 °C in SOC medium.
Prepare 50 mL starter cultures in dYT medium containing the appropriate antibiotic and grow 14 h at 37 °C.
Inoculate 1 L Terrific Broth containing 50 µg/mL kanamycin with 8 mL starter; grow at 37 °C, 180 rpm until OD₆₀₀ = 1.0.
Induce protein expression with 1 mM IPTG for ~18 h at 18 °C.

Harvest cells by centrifugation at 3 500 rcf for 30 min at 18‑20 °C; resuspend pellets in NiA buffer supplemented with 50 U DNase I, 2 mg/mL lysozyme, 1 µg/mL pepstatin, 1 µg/mL aprotinin, 1 µg/mL leupeptin, and 0.2 mg/mL AEBSF. Keep buffer on ice and use within 1 day.
Lyse cells by sonication (15 s on, 45 s off, total 2 min on, 70 % amplitude) and clarify lysate by centrifugation at 27 000 rcf for 30 min at 4 °C.
Adjust supernatant pH to 4.5 with glacial acetic acid; stir 30 min at 18‑20 °C to precipitate non‑ubiquitin proteins.
Clarify again by centrifugation at 27 000 rcf for 30 min at 4 °C (ubiquitin remains in supernatant).
Dialyze supernatant against 4 L cation buffer A using 3.5 kDa MWCO dialysis tubing for 14‑16 h at 4 °C (include 1 mM TCEP for MCM‑Ub).
Filter the dialysate and load onto a 5 mL HiTrap SP FF cation‑exchange column equilibrated with buffer A; elute with a 0‑350 mM NaCl gradient over 20 column volumes using buffers A and B.
Pool ubiquitin‑containing fractions, concentrate, and perform size‑exclusion chromatography on a Superdex 75 16/600 column equilibrated in GF buffer (include 1 mM TCEP for MCM‑Ub).

steps.title: Express and purify C‑terminal His6‑tagged ubiquitin
steps.instruction: Produce His6‑tagged wild‑type ubiquitin (Ub‑His) and His6‑tagged cysteine‑ubiquitin (MCM‑Ub‑His) and purify them by Ni‑NTA affinity followed by size‑exclusion chromatography, keeping cysteine reduced with 1 mM TCEP.

substeps.instruction: Express Ub‑His and MCM‑Ub‑His and lyse cells using the same procedure as steps 1‑6 above.
Incubate clarified lysates with Ni‑NTA agarose beads for 30 min (batch binding).
Wash beads with NiA buffer, then elute bound protein with NiA buffer containing 350 mM imidazole.
Concentrate eluates using a 3 kDa Amicon spin filter and purify by SEC on a Superdex 75 16/600 column equilibrated in GF buffer (include 1 mM TCEP for MCM‑Ub‑His).

steps.title: Express and purify Ube1, gp78RING‑Ube2g2, and PreScission protease
steps.instruction: Produce mouse E1 (Ube1), the gp78RING‑Ube2g2 E2‑E3 chimera, and PreScission protease, then purify each by Ni‑NTA affinity and size‑exclusion chromatography, removing the His‑tag from gp78RING‑Ube2g2 with TEV protease.

substeps.instruction: Express Ube1, gp78RING‑Ube2g2, and PreScission protease; lyse cells as described in steps 1‑6.
Incubate each clarified lysate with Ni‑NTA beads for 30 min.
Wash beads with NiA buffer and elute with NiA buffer plus 350 mM imidazole.
Treat the gp78RING‑Ube2g2 eluate with TEV protease at a TEV‑to‑E2‑E3 weight ratio of 1:200 for 14‑16 h at 4 °C to cleave the N‑terminal His6 tag.

Exchange the high‑imidazole buffer back to NiA buffer by repeated concentration/dilution, then perform a subtractive Ni‑NTA step to remove uncleaved gp78RING‑Ube2g2 and His‑tagged TEV protease; collect the flow‑through (tag‑cleaved gp78RING‑Ube2g2).

Concentrate the flow‑through (gp78RING‑Ube2g2) and the Ube1 and PreScission eluates with spin filters and run SEC: gp78RING‑Ube2g2 and PreScission on Superdex 75 16/600; Ube1 on Superdex 200 16/600; all columns equilibrated in GF buffer.

steps.title: Assemble Cy3‑Ub chains (Cy3Ub‑Ubn)
steps.instruction: Synthesize Lys‑48‑linked polyubiquitin chains where Cy3 is attached to the most proximal ubiquitin, then purify the His‑tagged Cy3‑Ub‑containing chains by Ni‑NTA chromatography and exchange into GF buffer (Timing ≈ 2–3 h).

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh ubiquitination buffer each day, keep DTT reduced, and store buffer at 4 °C.
In ubiquitination buffer, combine 50 µM Cy3Ub‑His, 100 µM unlabelled Ub, 1 µM mouse E1 (mE1), and 20 µM gp78RING‑Ube2g2.
Add ATP from a 500 mM stock to a final concentration of 10 mM and incubate 30 min at 37 °C (first elongation round).
Add unlabelled Ub to a final concentration of 100 µM and incubate another 30 min at 37 °C.
Repeat the addition‑incubation step (step 4) until the desired chain length (≈2‑6 ubiquitins) is achieved, monitoring by SDS‑PAGE.
Dilute the reaction with NiA buffer and pass it over Ni‑NTA resin; His‑tagged Cy3Ub‑Ubn binds, while untagged Ub‑Ubn chains and gp78RING‑Ube2g2 flow through.
Elute bound Cy3‑Ub chains with NiB buffer, then exchange NiB into GF buffer by three successive rounds of concentration and ten‑fold dilution with GF buffer.

steps.title: Assemble Cy3‑Ub chains (Ub‑Cy3Ub‑Ubn)
steps.instruction: Synthesize Lys‑48‑linked polyubiquitin chains where Cy3 is attached to the second ubiquitin, then extend them with unlabelled Ub and purify the final Ub‑Cy3Ub‑Ubn chains (Timing ≈ 3–4 h).

substeps.instruction: In ubiquitination buffer, mix 50 µM Ub‑His, 5 µM Cy3Ub, 1 µM mouse E1, and 20 µM gp78RING‑Ube2g2.

Add ATP to a final concentration of 10 mM and incubate; the goal is to generate primarily Ub‑Cy3Ub (and unreacted Ub‑His) while avoiding multiple Cy3Ub additions. Optimize the Ub‑His : Cy3Ub ratio as needed.
Dilute the reaction with NiA buffer and pass over Ni‑NTA resin; Ub‑Cy3Ub and any unreacted Ub‑His bind, whereas Cy3Ubn and gp78RING‑Ube2g2 remain in the flow‑through.
Concentrate and dilute the bound material repeatedly using a 3 kDa MWCO spin filter into NiA buffer.
Set up a second ubiquitination reaction by adding unlabelled Ub to the purified Ub‑Cy3Ub dimer in the same manner as the Cy3Ub‑Ubn assembly (add Ub in batches every ~30 min to control chain length).
After elongation, pass the reaction over Ni‑NTA resin again to capture the Ub‑Cy3Ub‑Ubn chains; elute with NiB buffer.
Exchange the NiB eluate into GF buffer by repeated concentration and dilution steps.
